verdict.rationale: The only model-related evidence says Sai is model-agnostic and lets you choose the model it plans with. That is model selection, an adjacent feature. Nothing documents pointing the agent at your own OpenAI-compatible or custom model endpoint, such as a base URL or API-key configuration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point the agent at my own model endpoint (OpenAI-compatible or otherwise) through documented configuration
